entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.165 requiring immediate deed recording and ten-year disposition of real estate acquired in debt settlements.

headings.title: Conveyance and immediate recording of property
headings.reviewNote: Requires real estate acquired in debt settlements to be conveyed directly to the institution and recorded immediately.

headings.title: Ten-year disposition period for acquired property
headings.reviewNote: Mandates sale of debt-settlement real estate within ten years unless occupied for banking purposes and requires separate earnings disclosure.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 362.170 setting bank lending limits, collateral exceptions, officer loan restrictions, class D felony penalties, and legacy charter exceptions.

headings.title: Definition and components of unimpaired capital
headings.reviewNote: Defines unimpaired capital including stock, surplus, and reserves while capping goodwill at ten percent for lending limits.

headings.title: Lending limits and population-based percentage tiers
headings.reviewNote: Restricts single-borrower loans to between fifteen and twenty-five percent of unimpaired capital based on CAMELS ratings and population.

headings.title: Exemptions for clearinghouse and correspondent balances
headings.reviewNote: Exempts daily clearinghouse settlement balances and correspondent bank balances from single-borrower lending limitations.

headings.title: First mortgage lending by nondeposit trusts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes trust companies precluding demand deposits to make first mortgage loans and deal in government obligations.

headings.title: Class D felony for willful excessive loans
headings.reviewNote: Makes any officer, director, agent, clerk, or employee who willfully and knowingly makes or concurs in an excessive loan guilty of a class D felony.

headings.title: Stock investment limits for nondeposit trusts
headings.reviewNote: Preserves pre-October 15, 1967 charter powers for banks and trust companies and exempts specified safe-deposit, bank-stock, and pre-January 1, 1915 real estate corporation holdings.

headings.title: Five-year lending transition following census updates
headings.reviewNote: Permits banks to continue applying prior lending limitations for up to five years after decennial census reclassifications.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.205 establishing accounting standards, security amortization rules, asset valuation caps, and director orders.

headings.title: Prohibition on disguised asset book entries
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits entering assets on books under names of other persons or under titles that are not truly descriptive.

headings.title: Book valuation and amortization of securities
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate securities to be booked at cost and amortized towards par value for undivided profit calculations.

headings.title: Valuation ceilings on premises and fixtures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits carrying real estate, premises buildings, and fixtures on books above lesser of actual cost or book value.

headings.title: Compliance with supervisory accounting orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires banks and trust companies to conform bookkeeping methods to accounting orders promulgated by the director.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.207 authorizing nominee registration for fiduciary securities, nominee liability, and asset segregation.

headings.title: Fiduciary registration of securities under nominee
headings.reviewNote: Permits qualifying banks and trust companies to register fiduciary investments in nominee names while retaining liability for nominee acts.

headings.title: Nominee recordkeeping and segregation of assets
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutional records to show actual ownership and mandates keeping nominee-registered investments strictly segregated from bank assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.222 requiring check settlement at par and establishing misdemeanor penalties for violations.

headings.title: Mandatory check settlement at par value
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits settling checks drawn on the institution at less than par except for special collection items.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for non-par check settlement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies settling checks below par as a misdemeanor and treats each unlawful settlement as a separate offense.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.235 establishing conversion and merger procedures from national to state banks and fiduciary succession.

headings.title: Conversion or merger of national banks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes national banking associations to convert into or consolidate with state-chartered banks or trust companies upon director approval.

headings.title: Board certification and dissenting shareholder rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires board certification of stockholder and federal approval, empowers completion of conversion, and preserves federal dissenting shareholder rights.

headings.title: Conversion articles, director examination, and property vesting
headings.reviewNote: Governs conversion articles permitting asset-paid capital, director examination and appeal rights, conversion certificates, and automatic vesting of property and fiduciary roles.

headings.title: Consolidation standards and dissenting shareholder rights
headings.reviewNote: Governs mergers, corporate continuity, and applies federal or state appraisal rights for dissenting shareholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.240 governing state bank conversion into national banks, franchise termination, and property vesting.

headings.title: Conversion or merger into national bank
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state banks and trust companies to convert into or merge with national banking associations under federal law.

headings.title: State franchise termination and notification filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing federal approval certificates with the director, whereupon the state franchise automatically terminates.

headings.title: Transfer of property and fiduciary appointments
headings.reviewNote: Vests all assets, franchises, and court-appointed fiduciary roles automatically into the resulting national bank without deeds or orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.245 establishing board size, director citizenship and residency rules, judgment disqualifications, and cumulative voting.

headings.title: Board size election terms and nonstockholder directors
headings.reviewNote: Establishes board size limits of five to thirty-five directors, annual shareholder elections, and staggered terms for trust companies in existence on October 13, 1967.

headings.title: Citizenship residency and process agent consents
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors to own qualifying stock unless waived for a private trust company under section 361.160, and mandates residency for a majority.

headings.title: Immediate vacancy upon disqualifying nonresidence
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors to take an oath of diligent administration and qualifying share ownership, subject to the section 361.160 private trust company exception.

headings.title: Disqualification of directors with unpaid judgments
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies any individual from serving as director against whom the bank or trust company holds an unsatisfied judgment.

headings.title: Bylaw authorization for cumulative voting
headings.reviewNote: Permits cumulative voting in director elections only when expressly provided for in articles of agreement or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.247 establishing board quorum standards, remote meeting attendance criteria, and director rulemaking.

headings.title: Board quorum and majority voting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a majority of the board constitutes a quorum and majority action of a quorum binds the corporation.

headings.title: Remote attendance via conference call or video
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remote attendance by telephonic or video conference and counting remote participants toward quorums absent prohibitions.

headings.title: Quorum verification criteria for remote directors
headings.reviewNote: Specifies minute recording, meeting notice, confidential presence, and audio clarity requirements for remote director participation.

headings.title: Rulemaking for remote board meeting integrity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of finance to promulgate reasonable regulations ensuring remote board operational integrity and safety.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.250 establishing director oath requirements, thirty-day filing deadlines, record retention, and forfeiture rules.

headings.title: Director qualification oath thirty-day deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires newly elected directors to qualify within thirty days by filing an oath pledging diligent administration and statutory compliance.

headings.title: Subscription certification and corporate minute entry
headings.reviewNote: Directs that director oaths be subscribed, certified by an authorized officer, and noted on board records.

headings.title: Retention with official board records
headings.reviewNote: Requires the signed and certified oath to be retained permanently with the official records of the board of directors.

headings.title: Position forfeiture and filling of vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Imposes automatic forfeiture of director positions for noncompliance unless extended by the director and governs filling vacancies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.260 governing director vacancies, stockholder elections, and interim board appointments.

headings.title: Stockholder election to fill board vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that vacancies in the office of directors are filled primarily by stockholder election except as authorized.

headings.title: Interim board appointment for minor vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Permits remaining directors to fill vacancies not exceeding one-third of the board until the next stockholder meeting.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.265 establishing stockholder and board authority to change director numbers and regulatory filing rules.

headings.title: Stockholder resolution altering board size
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes stockholders upon proper notice to alter the number of directors between five and thirty-five by majority vote.

headings.title: Interim board expansion by two directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors by two-thirds vote to add up to two directors annually subject to stockholder confirmation.

headings.title: Immediate filing with finance director
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate filing of certified copies of all director or stockholder board-size resolutions with the director.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.275 establishing regular board meeting schedules, loan review requirements, and unanimous consent alternatives.

headings.title: Mandatory regular meetings and transaction reviews
headings.reviewNote: Requires regular monthly board meetings and mandatory review of lists detailing large loans, extensions, and affiliated debts.

headings.title: Unanimous consent for immediate board action
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board or executive committee unanimous consent agreements under section 351.340(2) for issues needing immediate action, via facsimile or authenticated signed record.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.295 establishing condition reporting deadlines, officer oath verifications, late forfeiture penalties, and customer disclosures.

headings.title: Ten-day reporting deadline following supervisory notice
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written condition reports to the director within ten days of statutory notice detailing capital, assets, and liabilities.

headings.title: Officer verification of condition reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires reports to be verified under oath by executive officers certifying truth and accuracy to best knowledge.

headings.title: Special reports required by director
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director to require special condition reports in prescribed forms and with required verifications.

headings.title: Daily forfeiture penalty for late reports
headings.reviewNote: Assesses a one-hundred-dollar daily forfeiture for delinquent reports and makes willful failure to report or false statements a misdemeanor punishable by fine and jail.

headings.title: Customer copies provided upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions to provide paper or electronic copies of periodic condition reports to requesting customers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.315 establishing income determination rules, surplus allocations, dividend authorizations, and capital impairment prohibitions.

headings.title: Regulatory accounting of net income or loss
headings.reviewNote: Requires accounting for income and expenses under regulatory instructions and crediting net income to surplus or undivided profits.

headings.title: Dividend declarations from undivided profits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors to declare dividends deemed expedient from the credit balance of undivided profits.

headings.title: Prohibition on dividends during capital impairment
headings.reviewNote: Bars dividend payments while capital is impaired and imposes personal liability on assenting directors.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsections for 362.325 governing charter amendments, capital changes, voting procedures, relocation reviews, and certificates.

headings.title: Charter amendments and capital stock changes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks and trust companies to amend articles to increase or reduce stock, extend duration, or alter corporate powers.

headings.title: Stockholder meeting call and statutory notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires meeting call and statutory notice to be delivered in accordance with section 362.044.

headings.title: Meeting organization and majority representation
headings.reviewNote: Requires organization by electing a chairman and secretary upon attendance of at least a majority of voting shares.

headings.title: Stockholder vote canvass and recording
headings.reviewNote: Directs the meeting president to declare adopted propositions and enter proceedings into corporate records.

headings.title: Certified statement of proceedings and filings
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a certified statement of proceedings and full cash payment verifications with the director.

headings.title: Director examination and certificate issuance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to verify good faith statutory compliance and issue an official certificate of amendment.

headings.title: Relocation examinations and community need findings
headings.reviewNote: Requires community convenience and solvency examinations before approving charter amendments that relocate institutions to another community.

headings.title: Public filing of amendment certificates
headings.reviewNote: Directs delivery of certificates to institutions and filing of certified copies in division public records.

headings.title: Designation of chief executive officer authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards to designate a chief executive officer replacing the president for purposes of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.330 authorizing asset and business sales, stockholder consent thresholds, director approvals, and examinations.

headings.title: Authority to sell assets or business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to sell their whole or partial assets or banking business without impairing creditor rights.

headings.title: Two-thirds stockholder approval requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires consent of two-thirds of outstanding stock unless the director determines sale is an emergency necessity.

headings.title: Director consent and institution examination
headings.reviewNote: Conditions sales on director consent and authorizes examinations of participating institutions at applicant expense.

headings.title: Filing of certified corporate proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating institutions to file certified copies of board and stockholder proceedings prior to approval.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 362.331 establishing procedures for transferring fiduciary capacities to affiliated entities, notices, objections, and releases.

headings.title: Definitions of affiliated entity and fiduciary capacity
headings.reviewNote: Defines affiliated entity based on eighty percent common stock ownership and defines transferable fiduciary capacities.

headings.title: Assignment of fiduciary capacities to affiliates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transferring fiduciary capacities to affiliated entities without court approval or beneficiary consent.

headings.title: Application approval and notice to grantors
headings.reviewNote: Governs transfer applications, director evaluations, and thirty-day advance written notice to living grantors and beneficiaries.

headings.title: Newspaper publication of transfer approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires three consecutive weeks of newspaper notice of proposed fiduciary transfers, making transfers effective on the sixtieth day after publication unless objected to.

headings.title: Objection procedure and judicial resolution
headings.reviewNote: Allows objecting parties to petition the circuit court to determine whether fiduciary transfers serve the best interests of trust beneficiaries.

headings.title: Succession of transferred fiduciary appointments
headings.reviewNote: Treats subsequent testamentary and trust appointments naming transferor institutions as appointing the affiliated transferee.

headings.title: Release of transferor and itemized accounting
headings.reviewNote: Releases transferors from ongoing fiduciary liability, excludes prior breaches, and mandates itemized accountings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 362.332 governing transfers of fiduciary obligations between independent institutions, notices, objections, and probate hearings.

headings.title: Definitions of fiduciary obligation and institution entities
headings.reviewNote: Defines bank, trust company, and fiduciary obligation for statutory transfers between independent banking institutions.

headings.title: Transfer of fiduciary obligations by agreement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transferring fiduciary obligations and agreements to qualified institutions upon director approval without court orders.

headings.title: Regulatory approval application and grantor notifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' written notice to each living or existing beneficiary and grantor before transferring fiduciary obligations to an affiliated trust company.

headings.title: Newspaper publication and effective date calculation
headings.reviewNote: Mandates newspaper publication within twenty days of approval with transfers becoming effective thirty days after publication.

headings.title: Written objection and probate court petition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes grantors and beneficiaries to object and permits transferee probate court petitions to resolve adverse effect disputes.

headings.title: Release of transferor liability and cost caps
headings.reviewNote: Releases transferors from post-transfer liabilities, retains pre-transfer breach claims, and caps transfer fees at actual costs.

headings.title: Timing of designations and evaluation criteria
headings.reviewNote: Deems fiduciary designations based on execution circumstances and requires regulators and courts to assess beneficiary best interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.335 governing officer appointments, resolution prerequisites for debt pledges, and CEO designations.

headings.title: Board authority to appoint officers
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the board of directors to appoint and remove cashiers, secretaries, and other officers or employees at pleasure.

headings.title: Board resolution required for obligation transfers
headings.reviewNote: Renders officer endorsements or pledges of loan obligations void absent formal board resolution and certified corporate seal records.

headings.title: Designation of chief executive officer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes designating a chief executive officer in lieu of president and exempts majority owners from mandatory board membership.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.336 requiring consideration for cashier checks and certificates of deposit and establishing felony penalties.

headings.title: Exchange requirement for bank payment instruments
headings.reviewNote: Requires certificates of deposit, certified checks, and cashier checks to be issued solely in exchange for lawful money or equivalents.

headings.title: Felony penalties for unlawful instrument issuance
headings.reviewNote: Imposes felony imprisonment of two to five years and fines for issuing certificates or checks without receiving equivalent value.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.340 establishing fidelity bond mandates, casualty insurance authority, and annual board adequacy reviews.

headings.title: Mandatory fidelity bonding of active personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors to maintain good and sufficient fidelity bonds covering fraudulent, dishonest, or criminal acts of active personnel.

headings.title: Casualty and robbery insurance coverage
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors to require burglary, robbery, theft, and operational casualty insurance protection for the institution.

headings.title: Annual board review and regulatory guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual board review and minute recording of bond adequacy guided by published division coverage levels.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.345 prohibiting deposit acceptance during insolvency and imposing individual personal liability.

headings.title: Prohibition on receiving deposits during insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits officers and agents from receiving deposits or creating debts with knowledge of bank insolvency or failing conditions.

headings.title: Individual liability for insolvent deposits
headings.reviewNote: Imposes personal individual liability on violating officers for all deposits and debts accepted during known insolvency.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.360 authorizing interpleader petitions, fund retention pending judgment, and cost allocations.

headings.title: Interpleader petition for competing deposit claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits banks sued for deposits to petition the court on eight days' notice to interplead adverse claimants and require them to litigate their claims.

headings.title: Retention of disputed funds pending judgment
headings.reviewNote: Allows disputed deposits to remain with the institution bearing standard interest subject to court orders until final judgment.

headings.title: Judicial discretion over interpleader litigation costs
headings.reviewNote: Places action costs in the discretion of the court with authority to charge expenses against the disputed fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.375 defining restraining order prerequisites for adverse claims and third-party document discretion.

headings.title: Requirements to make adverse claim effectual
headings.reviewNote: Provides that adverse deposit claims are ineffectual without a court order or indemnifying bond, except upon an affidavit alleging fiduciary misappropriation.

headings.title: Discretion over third-party contract agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks and trust companies to honor, dishonor, or condition third-party contracts or agency documents until agreed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.410 establishing regulatory record retention schedules, reproduction rights, and disposal liability immunity.

headings.title: Division rules for record retention schedules
headings.reviewNote: Directs the division of finance to issue classification rules and minimum retention periods for bank books and records.

headings.title: Reproduction of records in bank custody
headings.reviewNote: Permits state-chartered banks to reproduce records in their custody as authorized under section 362.413.

headings.title: Immunity for lawful record disposal
headings.reviewNote: Shields banks and trust companies from liability for disposing of records in compliance with division retention rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.413 governing electronic record reproductions, business record affidavits, service rules, and witness excusal.

headings.title: Electronic and photographic reproduction of records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes financial institutions to reproduce and destroy original records using electronic, digital, or photographic media.

headings.title: Admissibility of records via business affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Allows business records to be admitted in evidence based on sworn custodian affidavits in lieu of court appearance.

headings.title: Seven-day advance service requirement for trial
headings.reviewNote: Requires serving record copies and affidavits on all parties at least seven days prior to commencement of trial.

headings.title: Statutory form for custodian business affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth the statutory affidavit form certifying business record creation in regular course and accurate reproduction.

headings.title: Excusal of personal court appearance
headings.reviewNote: Excuses the affiant from appearing in person before courts to authenticate records upon statutory compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.415 prohibiting unauthorized banking, voiding unlawful securities, and assessing one thousand dollar forfeitures.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized money circulation schemes
headings.reviewNote: Bars unauthorized persons from joining or financing entities organized to issue circulating notes or money.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized corporate banking powers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unauthorized domestic or foreign corporations from receiving deposits, discounting notes, or circulating money.

headings.title: Invalidity of securities given to unauthorized entities
headings.reviewNote: Renders void all notes and securities given to unauthorized corporations or associations for illegal banking loans.

headings.title: Prohibition on keeping unauthorized banking offices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits maintaining offices or issuing evidences of debt for circulation as money without express legal authorization.

headings.title: Statutory forfeiture penalty for unauthorized banking
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a forfeiture of one thousand dollars to the state on every person or corporation violating banking restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.422 incorporating federal Gramm-Leach-Bliley financial privacy restrictions and establishing notice timelines.

headings.title: Prohibition on unlawful privacy disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits disclosing nonpublic personal information contrary to Title V of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act and authorizes consistent state rules.

headings.title: Notice requirements for institution privacy policies
headings.reviewNote: Requires financial institutions to provide initial privacy policy notices to new customers on or after July 1, 2001, and existing customers before June 30, 2002, prior to nonaffiliated disclosures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsections for 362.424 establishing fraud reporting, trusted contact programs, account view features, and mutual civil immunities.

headings.title: Definitions of bank and trusted contact
headings.reviewNote: Defines bank and trusted contact for purposes of adult customer protective programs and fraud intervention.

headings.title: Reporting suspected fraud and civil immunity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to report suspected customer fraud or financial exploitation to law enforcement with civil immunity.

headings.title: Voluntary customer trusted contact program
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to implement voluntary programs allowing customers to designate trusted contacts for emergencies or exploitation.

headings.title: Account convenience and security features
headings.reviewNote: Permits banks to offer account features that limit transactions and grant view access to trusted contacts.

headings.title: Bank immunity for trusted contact actions
headings.reviewNote: Shields banks from liability arising out of any actions taken by customer-designated trusted contacts.

headings.title: Declining interaction in customer best interest
headings.reviewNote: Protects banks from liability for declining to interact with trusted contacts deemed not acting in customer interests.

headings.title: Immunity for good faith trusted contacts
headings.reviewNote: Confers civil immunity upon designated trusted contacts who act in good faith and exercise reasonable care.

headings.title: Customer appointment withdrawal and contact resignation
headings.reviewNote: Allows customers to revoke trusted contact appointments and permits trusted contacts to resign at any time.

headings.title: Broad immunity for program implementation decisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that banks incur no civil liability for implementing, declining to implement, or administering contact programs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.425 prohibiting unauthorized bank and trust company signage, setting fines and daily penalties, and authorizing director examinations under oath.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized bank signage
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unauthorized entities from using signs, titles, letterheads, or documents indicating that their business is a bank.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized trust company titles
headings.reviewNote: Bars unauthorized persons from using trust company in signs, titles, or marketing without state trust charter authorization.

headings.title: Fines and daily penalties for violations
headings.reviewNote: Punishes violations by a fine of one hundred to one thousand dollars plus fifty dollars per day for each day after written notice.

headings.title: Director examination and subpoena under oath
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to examine suspected violators' accounts, books, and papers and summon and examine persons under oath.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.430 establishing application certificate requirements, asset statements, and charter submissions for foreign banks.

headings.title: Application certificate for foreign bank license
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign banking corporations to submit an application certificate detailing capital, assets, and designating agency locations.

headings.title: Submission of charter and verified bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting an exemplified copy of corporate charter and verified bylaws with the foreign license application.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.435 setting prerequisites for foreign banking operations and exempting non-office real estate mortgage lenders.

headings.title: Prerequisites for foreign bank transaction authority
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits foreign banking corporations from operating without statutory capital, license issuance, and process agent designations.

headings.title: Exemption for mortgage lending without office
headings.reviewNote: Exempts foreign banking corporations lacking Missouri offices from prohibitions when making or acquiring mortgage loans on Missouri property.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.440 governing regulatory safety investigations, one-year license issuances, and annual renewal authority.

headings.title: Supervisory investigation of foreign applicant safety
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to investigate foreign bank applicants to determine whether business can be conducted safely and expediently.

headings.title: Issuance of one-year foreign banking license
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing a license valid for up to one year upon satisfaction of safety and statutory compliance criteria.

headings.title: Annual renewal of foreign corporation licenses
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director to renew foreign banking licenses annually upon expiration in the director's discretion.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.445 defining legal process, service rules, registered agents, director duties, and ten-dollar fees.

headings.title: Definition of legal process
headings.reviewNote: Defines process to include writs, summonses, petitions, or orders commencing any legal action or proceeding.

headings.title: Service under civil procedure rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes serving state or federal banks and thrifts under general Missouri corporate service of process rules.

headings.title: Appointment and registry of service agents
headings.reviewNote: Permits financial institutions to register Missouri service agents with the director for public reference.

headings.title: Director duties as statutory service attorney
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to forward copies of served process by prepaid mail to designated foreign banking officers.

headings.title: Statutory service fee and taxable costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires a ten-dollar fee collected by the director of revenue for each process served, recoverable as taxable costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.455 establishing license duration, conspicuous display rules, 24-hour surrender, and cessation upon revocation.

headings.title: Authorized scope and duration of license
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign banking corporations to engage in licensed business for one year at specified corporate locations.

headings.title: Nontransferability and conspicuous display mandate
headings.reviewNote: Makes foreign banking licenses nontransferable and requires conspicuous display at the licensed business location.

headings.title: Twenty-four-hour surrender upon license revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign corporations to surrender revoked licenses to the director within twenty-four hours of written notice.

headings.title: Immediate cessation of rights upon revocation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all corporate rights and privileges to transact business in Missouri terminate immediately upon license revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.460 requiring foreign bank condition reports under oath, penalties for noncompliance, and preservation of banking bars.

headings.title: Written condition reports under officer oath
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign banking corporations to submit written condition reports under officer oath in prescribed regulatory forms.

headings.title: Penalties for failure to report
headings.reviewNote: Subjects foreign corporations failing to report to section 362.295 penalties and establishes perjury for false statements.

headings.title: Preservation of general banking encroachments bar
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that reporting provisions do not modify or relax the unauthorized banking prohibitions of section 362.415.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 362.464 governing out-of-state bank relocation to Missouri, charter conversions, fiduciary vesting, and 30-mile outbound moves.

headings.title: Statutory relocation authority for out-of-state banks
headings.reviewNote: Bars out-of-state banks from relocating main offices to Missouri except in strict compliance with statutory relocation provisions.

headings.title: Relocation application and corporate approval certifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires the out-of-state bank's board to file a relocation application certifying approval by at least a majority of its shareholders.

headings.title: Articles of agreement and asset assignment
headings.reviewNote: Requires execution of articles of agreement and allows assigning existing assets in lieu of paid cash capital.

headings.title: Examination findings, approval, and appeal rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires director examinations confirming asset value and management fitness before granting the charter, with appeal rights if the director takes exception.

headings.title: Issuance and delivery of resulting certificate
headings.reviewNote: Directs the finance director to issue an official certificate recognizing the resulting Missouri-chartered bank or trust company.

headings.title: Corporate continuation and property vesting upon relocation
headings.reviewNote: Deems resulting institutions continuous corporate entities, automatically vesting property, franchises, and court-appointed fiduciary capacities.

headings.title: Thirty-mile outbound relocation by domestic banks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri banks to relocate up to thirty miles into another state and convert charters while transferring fiduciaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 362.470 governing joint tenancy accounts, conclusive survivorship, pledge rights, incompetency rules, and entirety presumptions.

headings.title: Joint tenancy deposits and survivor payment
headings.reviewNote: Establishes joint tenancy ownership, conclusive survivorship vesting, multiple-signature rules, and bank discharge upon payment.

headings.title: Survivorship among more than two depositors
headings.reviewNote: Provides that joint deposits with more than two persons pass to surviving joint tenants upon the death of one.

headings.title: Pledge of joint deposit to bank
headings.reviewNote: Validates pledges or assignments of joint accounts signed by authorized depositors without severing the joint tenancy.

headings.title: Effect of adjudication of depositor incompetency
headings.reviewNote: Provides that incompetency adjudications do not sever joint tenancies and authorizes guardian actions on incompetent accounts.

headings.title: Presumption of tenancy by the entirety
headings.reviewNote: Deems deposits made in names of spouses to be held as tenants by the entirety unless otherwise specified.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 362.471 establishing pay-on-death account contracts, survivorship rules, probate supremacy, and bank discharge.

headings.title: Contract form and sole lifetime control
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pay-on-death accounts granting the first-named holder sole property ownership and control during lifetime.

headings.title: Vesting upon death and withdrawal proof
headings.reviewNote: Vests title in designated pay-on-death beneficiaries upon the death of first-named owners subject to death verification.

headings.title: Multiple owners and equal beneficiary shares
headings.reviewNote: Deems multiple account owners joint tenants and divides proceeds equally among surviving pay-on-death beneficiaries.

headings.title: Contractual account terms permitted by agreement
headings.reviewNote: Permits banks and account holders to establish agreed contractual terms governing pay-on-death deposit accounts.

headings.title: Supremacy over probate and testamentary statutes
headings.reviewNote: Provides that pay-on-death account transfers override chapter 474 probate requirements and testamentary dispositions by will.

headings.title: Bank discharge absent court process restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Discharges banks from liability upon payment unless served with court process restricting disbursement on the account.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.483 authorizing incorporation of bank-owned safe deposit subsidiaries and limiting corporate purposes to bailment.

headings.title: Certificate of incorporation for subsidiary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of finance to grant incorporation certificates for bank-owned safe deposit subsidiaries.

headings.title: Authorized bailment and safekeeping business
headings.reviewNote: Restricts subsidiary business to bailment and safekeeping of valuables, securities, and leasing vault receptacles.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.487 authorizing joint safe deposit leases, exculpating lessors, and negating will custody presumptions.

headings.title: Joint box leases and survivor access
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes joint safe deposit leases, granting survivors access to remove contents without lessor liability or ownership presumptions.

headings.title: Absence of will custody presumption
headings.reviewNote: Eliminates presumptions of lessor will custody and permits box opening without employee presence upon lessee death.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.488 governing contractual safe deposit opening upon lessee death and mandatory responses to probate inquiries.

headings.title: Contractual duties upon lessee death
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes lessors to contract for box opening procedures, document delivery to courts, and burial deed turnover.

headings.title: Court inquiry regarding box tenancy
headings.reviewNote: Requires lessors to respond to probate court inquiries regarding whether a decedent rented a safe deposit box.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.490 exempting insured public deposits from collateral and authorizing single-bank pooled security programs.

headings.title: Security exemption for federally insured deposits
headings.reviewNote: Exempts banks from furnishing collateral or surety bonds to secure public deposits to the extent federally insured.

headings.title: Single bank pooled collateral security method
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to secure excess public deposits through a pooled security method using approved collateral assets.

headings.title: Administrator appointment and pooling program rules
headings.reviewNote: Grants the director exclusive authority to appoint a pooling administrator and establishes collateral monitoring requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.500 requiring immediate notice of payment suspension and directing supervisory oversight for sixty days.

headings.title: Mandatory notice of payment suspension
headings.reviewNote: Requires bank executive officers to notify the finance director immediately upon suspending check payments or asset withdrawals.

headings.title: Supervisory charge during sixty-day suspension
headings.reviewNote: Directs the finance director to take charge and supervise banking operations and asset withdrawals for sixty days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 362.520 governing bank holiday closures, emergency closings, next-business-day performance, and branch repair pauses.

headings.title: Sunday holiday and optional fixed closures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to close on Sundays, public holidays, and fixed weekdays adopted upon fifteen days' board notice.

headings.title: Emergency closures for life safety threats
headings.reviewNote: Permits emergency bank closures when lives, safety, or institutional security are threatened by disasters, weather, or emergencies.

headings.title: Legal holiday effect on commercial transactions
headings.reviewNote: Deems authorized closing days legal bank holidays for chapter 400 purposes and relieves closed institutions from providing safe-deposit vault access.

headings.title: Next business day performance of obligations
headings.reviewNote: Allows contractual payments and condition performances due on closing days to be performed on the next business day.

headings.title: Independent emergency closing of branch offices
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes branch offices to close during emergencies without creating bank holidays unless the main banking house closes.

headings.title: Temporary branch closure for repair operations
headings.reviewNote: Permits temporary branch closures for repairs or remodeling upon posting notice and notifying the finance director at least thirty days in advance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 12 subsections for 362.550 governing trust company appointments, capital liability, property segregation, merger succession, and mutual funds.

headings.title: Grant of letters testamentary to nominees
headings.reviewNote: Requires probate courts to grant letters testamentary to trust companies nominated as personal representatives in wills.

headings.title: Appointment on application in intestate estates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing trust companies as personal representatives when no person is entitled or upon application of entitled parties.

headings.title: Fiduciary appointments and fiduciary substitution petitions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing trust companies as fiduciaries and permits substitution upon application of individual fiduciaries.

headings.title: Fiduciary bond reduction via asset deposit
headings.reviewNote: Permits individual fiduciaries to petition the court for a reduced bond upon limiting powers and depositing estate assets with a trust company.

headings.title: Capital liability for trust investments
headings.reviewNote: Makes capital stock liable for fiduciary investment losses unless investments are authorized by court or instrument terms.

headings.title: Court supervision and accounting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Empowers courts or officers to issue orders respecting trusts and require trust companies to render all accounts required of natural-person fiduciaries.

headings.title: Official oath not required upon appointment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no official oath shall be required of a trust company upon appointment to any fiduciary office.

headings.title: Special deposit and segregation of trust property
headings.reviewNote: Requires trust property to be held as a separate special deposit, unmingled and shielded from corporate debts, within a distinct trust department.

headings.title: Inspection of trust records by interested parties
headings.reviewNote: Requires all accounts, securities, and records of a trust company relating to a trust to be open to inspection.

headings.title: Transfer of fiduciary roles upon merger
headings.reviewNote: Transfers fiduciary appointments and trust property to a merged or consolidated trust company upon company election, court filing, court approval, and required bond.

headings.title: Mutual fund and affiliated entity investments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes fiduciary investments in affiliated mutual funds or private investment funds without reduction of normal fiduciary fees.

headings.title: Scope and definition of trust company
headings.reviewNote: Defines trust company to apply to any state or national bank or trust company qualified as a fiduciary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.570 establishing guaranty fund pledges for fiduciary duties and restricting capital transfers.

headings.title: Pledge of guaranty fund for fiduciary duties
headings.reviewNote: Pledges the trust guaranty fund absolutely to secure fiduciary duties without relieving capital stock or general funds.

headings.title: Transfer restrictions while fiduciary undertakings uncompleted
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transferring guaranty funds to general capital while bonded fiduciary obligations remain uncompleted.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.580 authorizing common trust fund establishment and applying provisions to all fiduciary relationships.

headings.title: Establishment of common trust investment funds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified banks and trust companies to establish common trust funds for collective investment of fiduciary assets.

headings.title: Application to existing and future relationships
headings.reviewNote: Applies common trust fund investment authority to all fiduciary relationships whether previously or subsequently established.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 362.600 establishing reciprocal out-of-state fiduciary qualifications, reciprocity certificates and revocation, Missouri trust office conditions, and service of process.

headings.title: Definition of out-of-state banking entities
headings.reviewNote: Defines out-of-state bank or trust company to include state-chartered banks, national banks, and federal thrifts located outside Missouri.

headings.title: Reciprocal authority for out-of-state fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes out-of-state institutions to act in Missouri fiduciary capacities without foreign licensing provided their home states grant reciprocal rights.

headings.title: Scope of fiduciary acts and appointments
headings.reviewNote: Permits reciprocal fiduciaries to act with or without resident cofiduciaries, use corporate names, and receive court appointments.

headings.title: Application requirements for reciprocity certificate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes filing requirements, charter proofs, home-state reciprocity verifications, and irrevocable process consents for certificates.

headings.title: Duration and revocation of reciprocity certificates
headings.reviewNote: Keeps reciprocity certificates in effect until eligibility ceases and the director revokes them by written notice, preserving ongoing fiduciary matters.

headings.title: Conditions for physical trust offices in Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits out-of-state fiduciaries from maintaining Missouri trust offices or branches unless under Missouri bank control, merger or federal branch authority, or reciprocal office authority.

headings.title: Non-transacting-business status without physical office
headings.reviewNote: Provides that an out-of-state fiduciary acting under this section is not deemed to be transacting business in Missouri if it maintains no Missouri office, branch, or agency.

headings.title: Service of process on finance director
headings.reviewNote: Deems certificate holders to appoint the finance director as attorney for service of process, sets registered-mail forwarding and record duties, and permits service at Missouri trust offices.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.680 establishing 60-day stockholder submission deadlines, meeting notices, and emergency failure waivers.

headings.title: Stockholder submission deadline following director approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires merger or consolidation agreements to be submitted to stockholders of each participating institution within sixty days of approval.

headings.title: Notice requirements for stockholder merger meetings
headings.reviewNote: Directs that stockholder meetings to vote on mergers or consolidations be called with statutory notice under section 362.044.

headings.title: Stockholder vote waiver for emergency mergers
headings.reviewNote: Waives stockholder meetings for imminent-failure, failed-bank takeover, or wholly owned holding-company mergers while preserving section 362.730 dissenting stockholder rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.700 governing corporate minute filings and effective dates of completed bank mergers.

headings.title: Filings required for merger agreement ratification
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing certified stockholder meeting minutes, approved merger agreements, and director approval in division of finance public records and with each party's cashier or secretary.

headings.title: Effective date of completed bank merger
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the merger agreement and corporate merger become effective according to their terms upon filing required records.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.710 establishing filing requirements and effective dates for bank and trust company consolidations.

headings.title: Filings required for corporate consolidation ratification
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing certified stockholder proceedings, consolidation agreements, and director approval in division of finance public records and with each party's cashier or secretary.

headings.title: Effective date of completed consolidation agreement
headings.reviewNote: Makes corporate consolidation effective according to its terms upon filing approved proceedings in division records, provided legal incorporation fees are paid.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.730 establishing dissenting shareholder appraisal petitions, valuation rights, and appointment of appraisers.

headings.title: Appraisal petition rights for dissenting shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenting shareholders in mergers, consolidations, or reverse splits to petition circuit courts within sixty days for valuation.

headings.title: Judicial hearing order and appraiser appointments
headings.reviewNote: Requires courts within five days of deadline expiration to schedule hearings and appoint three disinterested appraisers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.740 governing appraiser report filings, compensation, and mandatory minority and marketability discounts.

headings.title: Appraisal report filing and clerk notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires appraisers to forthwith determine cash value not less than current book value, file written reports concurred in by two appraisers, and provides for clerk notice and court-fixed compensation.

headings.title: Mandatory minority and marketability stock discounts
headings.reviewNote: Mandates applying minority discounts and lack-of-marketability discounts when valuing stock of dissenting minority shareholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 362.765 governing bank mergers with nonbank subsidiaries, regulatory standards, appeals, and power limits.

headings.title: Definitions of nonbank affiliate and subsidiary
headings.reviewNote: Defines nonbank affiliate, nonbank business entity, and nonbank subsidiary for purposes of corporate bank mergers.

headings.title: Merger authority with surviving bank charter
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state-chartered banks with director approval to merge with nonbank subsidiaries or affiliates if the bank survives.

headings.title: Regulatory review and thirty-day decision timeline
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting merger agreements to the director for action within thirty days based on transaction purpose, safety and soundness, and customer impact.

headings.title: Administrative appeals of nonbank merger decisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that director merger decisions may be appealed to the state banking and savings and loan board.

headings.title: Effective date certification for business filings
headings.reviewNote: Directs the finance director to provide merger completion certifications for presentation to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Limitation on expansion of banking powers
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that nonbank subsidiary mergers do not enable surviving banks to exercise powers not previously held under law.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.780 establishing automatic corporate succession to fiduciary relationships and vesting of trust property.

headings.title: Automatic succession to fiduciary relations and roles
headings.reviewNote: Provides that resulting corporations succeed to all fiduciary appointments, trusts, and court roles without further acts or deeds.

headings.title: Vesting of fiduciary property upon consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Vests all fiduciary property rights automatically into resulting entities, requiring transfers to successor trustees if powers are lacking.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.820 requiring sixty-day advance notice for nondeposit trust acquisitions and specifying disapproval grounds.

headings.title: Sixty-day prior notice for trust acquisitions
headings.reviewNote: Requires sixty days' prior written notice to the director before acquiring control of a trust company, exempting deposit-taking and bank-holding-company-owned trust companies.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for acquisition disapproval orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to disapprove acquisitions based on management competence, integrity, financial instability, or non-cooperation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 362.920 establishing holding company acquisition procedures, 30-day orders, public interest reviews, and failure exemptions.

headings.title: Holding company application and thirty-day order
headings.reviewNote: Requires bank holding companies to file federal application copies and directs the director to issue legality orders within thirty days.

headings.title: Public interest evaluations and federal objections
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to evaluate safety, soundness, liquidity, and credit effects, communicating objections to the Federal Reserve Board.

headings.title: Exemption for emergency imminent failure acquisitions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts holding company acquisitions undertaken at regulatory request to prevent imminent bank failure from application procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.923 governing Federal Reserve cooperative examination agreements and supervisory authority over trust holding companies.

headings.title: Cooperative examination agreements with federal reserve
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to enter into cooperative examination and information-sharing agreements with federal reserve banks at twelve-month intervals.

headings.title: Trust holding company acquisition and supervision
headings.reviewNote: Establishes regulatory authority, applications, and safety agreements for trust holding companies acquiring nondepositary trust companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 362.945 defining interstate banking terms and authorizing cooperative regulatory agreements and joint examinations.

headings.title: Definitions of affiliate bank and business
headings.reviewNote: Defines affiliate, out-of-state bank, bank holding company, and engaging in the banking business.

headings.title: Reciprocal examination agreements for interstate entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperative examination agreements, joint regulatory actions, and report sharing for interstate banks and holding companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 362.950 authorizing affiliated bank agency transactions, 30-day notices, 80-percent ownership definitions, and interstate agency agreements.

headings.title: Authorized agency transactions for affiliated entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes banks to receive deposits, cash checks, and service loans as agents for affiliated banking entities.

headings.title: Thirty-day advance notice of agency operations
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' prior written notice to the director before conducting affiliated agency transactions.

headings.title: Definition of affiliated entity eighty percent
headings.reviewNote: Defines affiliated entity based on eighty percent direct or indirect common voting stock ownership or control.

headings.title: Interstate agency agreements under Riegle-Neal act
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interstate agency transactions with out-of-state institutions pursuant to the federal Riegle-Neal Interstate Banking Act.
